description: Synthetic .NET, JavaScript, TypeScript, frontend, SQL, and mixed-repository mutation guardrails for invariance, bounded marginality, semantic directionality, generated and duplicate exclusion, bounded SQL seed data, represented quality and delivery behavior, range directionality, and category isolation.

cases.description: Minimal maintained .NET library used as the .NET reference case.
The maintained .NET behavior is reformatted without semantic changes.
An exact .NET source copy excluded from compilation is added.
A conventional generated .NET source body is added.

A nested TypeScript unit-test package is added while both production modules remain unchanged.

A JavaScript behavior-and-test case has no declared coverage threshold.
The same JavaScript behavior and tests declare an assumed 80 percent global coverage threshold.

A static Angular component owns external template and SCSS assets with represented UI semantics.

A byte-identical maintained SQL body is added.
A conventional generated SQL database dump is added.
Schema, index, view, stored-program, CTE, window, join, and query semantics replace the base schema.
A maintained SQL integration-test fixture is added without changing production schema semantics.
A maintained SQL installation script is added without changing production schema semantics.
A maintained attached-database query adds an explicit cross-database integration boundary.
A maintained SQL seed artifact contains one representative row.
The same maintained SQL seed intent is repeated across twenty rows.
An unknown vendor-specific SQL statement is added beside the maintained base schema.
